title: Elizondo in Gray Fox, and JSOC's link to crash retrievals

tellings.quote: according to Future guest of this show Matthew Pines blou even was a member of the US Army intelligence support activity group otherwise known as gray fox
my buddy Matt Pines made the connection that Lou Alzando is actually part of this group called Gray Fox.
tellings.link_reason: Both relay Matt Pines's claim that Elizondo was a member of Gray Fox (the Intelligence Support Activity).

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that according to Matthew Pines, who was set to be a future guest, Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who has spoken publicly about UFOs, was once a member of the US Army Intelligence Support Activity, a secretive military intelligence unit nicknamed Gray Fox. Michels links this to JSOC, the Joint Special Operations Command that oversees America's elite special forces, which the story ties to recovering crashed UFOs. If true, it would put Elizondo close to the people said to retrieve such craft.
